senses.gloss: f. (preced. wds.) kiss (of the foot), a form of taking possession of a slave.
units: Gitt. 43ᵇ מאי נמוסו … נ׳ what is meant by the gentile’s doing to the slave his nomos (v. נִימוֹס)? (Answer.) נ׳.
Ib. שדה בת נ׳ הוא can a field be taken possession of by nashḳi?—[Ar. armor, Rashi seal, suspended from the slave’s neck].
